dolly in.prompt: The camera glides forward toward the subject in one continuous movement. Nearby objects slide past faster than the distant background as the subject grows larger. One continuous shot.

orbit.prompt: The camera circles all the way around the subject at a steady height and distance, revealing front, side, back and front again in a continuous shot. One continuous shot.

crane up.prompt: The camera lifts above the subject and gradually points downward. More of the surrounding ground becomes visible as the subject recedes below. One continuous shot.

pull back reveal.prompt: Beginning close to the subject, the camera retreats smoothly into a wide shot. Surrounding scenery progressively enters at the edges and reveals the larger setting. One continuous shot.

handheld.prompt: Small irregular camera movements drift gently up, down and sideways, like a person holding a camera while standing still. The subject remains clearly visible. One continuous shot.

static.prompt: The camera holds exactly the same viewpoint and framing throughout the shot. Motion belongs to the subject and the environment inside the stationary frame. One continuous shot.
